title: Chart-Overlap Idempotent Extraction
interpretation: The (-1)^81 chart-overlap eigenspace is exactly the left-nullspace of the chart/nonedge incidence matrix H. This is a genuine local K33 chart-balance 81-sector.
boundary: This 81-sector is not automatically the Levi Hodge idempotent E4. A BT699 lift selector/intertwiner is required to compare it to the 160-flag Levi cycle sector.
